intro.title: Our 7-Phase Engineering Lifecycle
intro.description: A structured, transparent process that keeps delivery predictable and quality high, from the first conversation to long-term improvement.

phases.title: Discovery & Requirements
phases.detail: We analyze your business objectives, operational challenges, project expectations, and technical landscape to establish a solid foundation.

phases.title: Planning & Architecture
phases.detail: We define the project scope, technical architecture, development milestones, technology stack, and delivery strategy.

phases.title: Design & Prototyping
phases.duration: Runs alongside planning and early build
phases.detail: We craft user interfaces, design systems, technical specifications, and interactive prototypes for early validation.

phases.title: Engineering & Development
phases.detail: Our distributed engineering team builds the solution using modern frameworks, clean code practices, and modular patterns.

phases.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
phases.duration: Continuous, with a dedicated pre-release pass
phases.detail: Rigorous automated and manual testing validates functionality, performance, security, and edge-case reliability.

phases.title: Deployment & Delivery
phases.detail: We configure production infrastructure, containerized deployments, and monitoring pipelines, then complete the agreed handover.

phases.title: Maintenance & Improvement
phases.detail: We provide ongoing improvements, technical support, security patches, and scaling optimizations as your needs evolve.
